result.summary: Found several visual/content bugs: a broken delivery fee showing '€NaN', truncated restaurant names, and a partially cut-off category chip.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers shows delivery fee as '€NaN delivery', indicating a null/undefined price was formatted as a number.
issues.suggestion: Guard against null/undefined delivery fees in the UI (show a fallback like '—' or hide the fee) and fix the data/API so a valid numeric fee is always provided.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you carousel card.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or truncate with an ellipsis (…) so the name doesn’t look broken.

issues.description: The last category filter chip ('Healthy') is clipped at the right edge with no clear affordance that more categories exist.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal padding so the last fully visible chip isn’t hard-clipped, or add a fade/scroll hint if the row is intentionally scrollable.
